payload.summary: The incident involves a brute-force attack targeting the labadmin account on victim-web-01 from the IP address 198.51.100.23. There were 15 failed login attempts within a short time window, and no successful logins were recorded from this source. The account is protected and privileged, making it a high-value target.

attack_chain.description: An attacker attempted to gain access to the labadmin account on victim-web-01 by performing a brute-force attack using the IP address 198.51.100.23.

risk_factors: No successful logins from the attacking IP

proposed_actions.justification: The account is a high-value target and has been subjected to a brute-force attack. Disabling the account can prevent further unauthorized access.
